svg.title: Lab 3: a policy answer crosses the A2A boundary with citations
svg.desc: Illustrative delegation. The coordinator checks prior authorization for Northwind Health Plan and CARD-MRI, calls ask_policy_expert through APIM, and receives an answer with a PA-001 document and section citation from care-knowledge-agent.

g.text: LAB 03 / BRING IN A POLICY EXPERT
Delegate the question. Preserve the sources.
Northwind Health Plan + CARD-MRI / required: true
Ask a self-contained question including the payer and procedure code.
Remote answer + document and section citations from the policy knowledge base
Sources: PA-001 + the returned section reference
CHECKPOINT: tool call + remote-agent boundary + final-answer citation
Compare the final citation with the remote response. Fluency alone is not proof.
Illustrative summary, not policy advice. Keep missing-citation cases for Lab 5.
